name: Conqueror
description: Basic attacks or spells that deal damage to an enemy champion grant 2 stacks of Conqueror for 5s, gaining 1.8-4 Adaptive Force per stack. Stacks up to 12 times. Ranged champions gain only 1 stack per basic attack.<hr class='effect-hr'>When fully stacked, heal for 8% of the damage you deal to champions (5% for ranged champions).
